main.description: A "notify me" subscription: either a specific rated site (alert on a new very-low rating) or a genre/subgenre/super-genre (alert on a new site release in scope). One record per subscribed thing — unsubscribing deletes the record. Written and read by rateyourbuild (https://rateyourbuild.bisks.net).

kind.description: What this subscription watches: a site's own ratings, or a genre/subgenre/super-genre's new releases.

target.description: The bare site name, genre key, subgenre value, or super-genre key being watched, depending on kind.

genre.description: Required when kind is "subgenre" (subgenre names aren't unique across genres, e.g. "leaderboard"), so a subgenre subscription is always scoped to a (genre, subgenre) pair. Unused for other kinds.

createdAt.description: When this subscription was created, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
